Q: How do I create formatted javascript console log messages A:

Won't work in Firefox

BUT, It appear that WEBKIT based browsers console are also supporting ANSI escape sequences, like do terminals.

How to use them is a long ride, but the basis of text transformation can be done as follow:

console.info('\033[9mStrike\033[0m')
console.info('\033[4mUnderline\033[0m')
console.info('\033[2mDimmed\033[0m')
console.info('\033[1mBold\033[0m')
console.info('\033[3mItalic \033[0m')
console.info('\033[5mBlinking does not work, someone fix this ASAP\033[0m')
console.info('\033[31mANSI \033[32;4;1m8 BIT\033[0m \033[33mCOLOR\033[0m')

And we could pass a SVG 🎩 with some CSS.

console.log("%c  ","font-size:250px;background:url(\"data:image/svg+xml,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 10 10'><text y='0.95em' font-size='8'>🎩</text></svg>\")")

https://stackoverflow.com/a/79190595/2494754

Q: Append results of a filter within results of another filter A: 
=JOIN(", ", FILTER(Tracking!$F$2:$F & " (" & TEXT(Tracking!$A$2:$A, "dd/mm/yyyy") & ")", Tracking!$B$2:$B=$A3, (Tracking!$I$2:$I="1. Shipped")+(Tracking!$I$2:$I="2. Received"), Tracking!$G$2:$G=AU$2))

To achieve the format "Recipient name (Date)", you need to modify the first argument of your FILTER function.

Instead of filtering just the Recipient Name column (Tracking!$F$2:$F), you can construct a combined text string using both the Recipient Name and the Date columns directly inside the formula.

Q: php artisan migrate:fresh --seed can't seed a table into MySQL A:

Helpful for Future Readers

When you create files using:

php artisan make:model Product -mcr # -mcr is short of -m -c -resource

Laravel generates everything following its naming conventions:

  • Model -> app/Models/Product.php -> singular
  • Migration -> create_products_table.php -> plural
  • Controller -> app/Http/Controllers/ProductController.php
  • Table Name -> products (Laravel automatically pluralizes the model name)

Do You Need protected $table?

No, not if you follow Laravel's conventions. By default, Eloquent maps the Product model -> products table automatically.

You only need to define protected $table when your model name and table name don't match. For example:

class Product extends Model
{
    // Custom table name because migration/table is different
    protected $table = 'product_data';
}

Best Practices

  • Always name models in singular: Product, User, Order

  • Always name tables in plural: products, users, orders

  • Use make:model with the -mcr flags to:

    • -m -> create migration
    • -c -> create controller
    • --resource (-r) -> generate a RESTful controller
